shadowChallengers.rule: Promotion requires >=30 reconciled real fills and positive shrunk expectancy; live risk caps never increase automatically.

missedFillAnalysis.rule: Only Robinhood-confirmed submitted/working/cancelled/filled orders may be used to judge missed fills or execution quality.

portfolioAllocation.rule: Allocate only among already-qualified entries after live Robinhood cash, spread, correlation, aggregate stop-risk and portfolio-heat checks. Discovery score never increases an existing risk ceiling.

timeOfDayLearning.authority: May reorder/reduce/disable after sufficient real-fill evidence; may not create eligibility.

walkForward.rule: Strategy changes require out-of-sample or forward shadow evidence before promotion; never optimize solely on the same period used to design the rule.

policy: Find more opportunities aggressively, but require a valid two-sided quote, at least $20M observed daily dollar volume, and <=0.35% spread before liquidity can pass. Missing quote data never counts as a pass. Discovery/catalyst/liquidity intelligence may only promote symbols into research, reorder, reduce, or block; it never directly creates broker execution eligibility.
